mostWorthwhile.text: Building the gravity and acceleration organs was most worthwhile: the planned comparison distinguishes head tilt and starting motion from steady motion.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate nerve and reflex pathway fittings felt somewhat repetitive, although they established the route to the brainstem and its outputs.

surprise.text: I expected to connect the rotation sensors directly to nerves, but the feedback showed that the two balance organs had to be assembled together first.

arbitrary.text: Combining both organ types before adding nerves felt like an imposed assembly order rather than an explained biological requirement. The term “otolith organs” also appeared without an explicit definition, though the weighted-membrane picture helped.

continue.text: Yes. The contrast between the sensors and the final connection to eye movements made me curious to see another system connected in a similarly concrete way.
